theorems.name: Submission.f036cc6b1f_hecke_commute
theorems.statement: ∀ (M : ℕ) [NeZero M] (p r : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hr : r.Prime) (hpM : ¬ p ∣ M) (hrM : ¬ r ∣ M), (CuspForm.heckeTLin 2 hp hpM).comp (CuspForm.heckeTLin 2 hr hrM) = (CuspForm.heckeTLin 2 hr hrM).comp (CuspForm.heckeTLin 2 hp hpM)
theorems.natural_summary: Equal primes give identical operators by proof irrelevance. For distinct primes, apply the existing exact Hecke coefficient formula twice. Coprimality and four divisibility cases give equal coefficients, including index zero. Existing q-expansion uniqueness and linear-map extensionality yield equality of the compositions.
